claim_boundary: Determinex is local-first where supported, not guaranteed offline for every possible workflow.
Private code and user project material are not training data by default.
Proof reports are receipts, not consent to train and not release readiness.
Source mutation remains under explicit user/operator authority gates.
Sensitive data does not travel by default.
Unknown/novel requests remain routed, NOT_CLAIMED, and blocked until concrete fixtures/verifiers exist.
Commercial licensing is a separate boundary.
purpose: Make Determinex's privacy, source-control, local-first, and training boundaries explicit, machine-checkable, user-readable, and report-integrated without granting training, telemetry, source mutation, release support, broad claims, or universal support.
